name: base_utils
description: Manages shared host utilities, including an optional /etc/motd and a Hiera-provided list of utility packages.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Prepares a Python application runtime, deploys the application from Git, configures PostgreSQL connectivity, and manages its service, monitoring, and logging.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Installs and configures HAProxy with data-driven backend definitions, optional discovery and TLS, service management, and firewall integration.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Configures the PostgreSQL package repository, installs the requested PostgreSQL version and packages, and starts or enables the service.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Installs and configures Redis with authentication, persistence, memory limits, and an attempted PuppetDB-based node-discovery mechanism.
